bug_semantics: PostgresTrigger interpolates attacker-controlled PostgreSQL identifiers (additionalFields.functionName, triggerName, and channelName, plus listenTrigger channelName) into DDL and LISTEN/UNLISTEN statements without quoting. pg-promise :raw splices those strings into CREATE/REPLACE FUNCTION, CREATE/DROP TRIGGER, and pg_notify channel literals, and the trigger path also ran LISTEN ${channelName}. An authenticated user who can configure/execute the node therefore injects arbitrary SQL against the connected PostgreSQL instance under the configured credential.
flaw_origin: The first write of user-supplied identifier interpolation is GitHub-reconstructable PR #5495 member 4b06a2c6f9e77415868bfc66068c804c1d0e9be2 (2023-02-16), which replaced hardcoded CREATE FUNCTION public.test()/pg_notify('new_testevent') with additionalFields.functionName/triggerName/channelName passed through $1:raw/$2:raw/$4:raw. Immediate parent da5551fe4a9217750de41b7b80727db31ae73483 still used the hardcoded literals. The same :raw templates survived squash-merge 4488f93c39b0ec0b4a0eff98391b46db6a2eed78 (feat: New trigger PostgreSQL #5495) and the later prepareNames refactor 491378de772670b640be23e3b9bc7eadad6d3ebe until the 2026 identifier-validation fix.

reasoning: CVE-2026-72775 is a real published CWE-89 in n8n PostgresTrigger: user-supplied function/trigger/channel identifiers were spliced into SQL with pg-promise :raw and LISTEN string interpolation, so an authenticated workflow editor could execute arbitrary SQL as the Postgres credential. Vendor GHSA-jqwr-vx3p-r266 and CVE.org both treat this as a live advisory (not withdrawn/rejected), so FALSE_POSITIVE is inapplicable. The BIC search started from the vulnerable :raw/LISTEN lines, not from AI-marked commits. git log -S/-L on the landed files points at squash 4488f93c39 as the first reachable master object; PR #5495 members remain public on GitHub. Reconstructing those members, da5551fe still hardcodes public.test()/new_testevent, and 4b06a2c6 is the smallest commit that first wrote the user-identifier :raw interpolation; its parent exists and lacks that mechanism. Later 413f942b only adds LISTEN ${channelName}, and 491378de77 is a refactor that preserves :raw, so neither is a new BIC. 4b06a2c6 is a February 2023 human commit (agobrech) with no commit-object AI markers; the squash that landed it is likewise human (agobrech, Co-authored-by Marcus only). Cursor/Claude trailers appear only on the 2026 fix branch/bundle, which cannot attribute the BIC. The identifier-validation fix first hits master in 2222fe3a6c and is cherry-picked to the GHSA boundaries via 1cd2c5fb22 (1.123.67), f6cb6cf3ab (2.31.5), and f69dfc6dd2 (2.32.1), matching affected-range membership.
